title: MCP tools silently disappear after in-app upgrade: transitive plugin stuck on the previous rc with exact peers

reported.symptom: after the in-app upgrade to 0.2.1-rc.3 every mcp__<server>__* tool disappeared; the stdio child was never spawned; nothing user-discoverable was logged (logs.db empty)
reported.runtime_trace: the upgrade reinstalled profile deps pinned to rc.3 but left the transitive @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client at 0.2.1-rc.2; the plugin has no engines.dsh and pins every @deepseek-ai/dsh-* peer to the exact version 0.2.1-rc.2, so the boot compatibility gate rejected it before spawn
user_hypotheses: Windows agent sandbox blocking the MCP child (ruled out: harness spawns it outside the sandbox)
Chrome 156 / Playwright incompatibility (ruled out: stdio JSON-RPC probe worked end to end)
config loss in cordis.patch.yml (ruled out: entry and paths intact)
Crashpad 0xFFFF7001 misread as a sandbox denial (documented red herring)
reported.root_cause: exact @deepseek-ai/dsh-* peer pins on 0.2.1-rc.2 vs runtime 0.2.1-rc.3 -> admission rejects the row pre-spawn
reported.fix_verified_by_reporter: pnpm add --save-exact @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client@0.2.1-rc.3 -> restart -> tools returned in new sessions

deviations: bundles omitted: the report is about one MCP row in cordis.patch.yml
the transitive install is modelled as a directly resolved version (real manifest bytes; the pnpm lockfile itself is not reproduced)
node_modules is reconstructed from the published manifests, not a full install
the reporter verified the fix on their machine; this case cannot re-verify the symptom disappearing
